name: julesdeck
description: JulesDeck — Native Linux Desktop Client for Google Jules with Local Mode & Multi-Account Switcher

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/chrome/assets && cp -r src/chrome/assets/. dist/chrome/assets/ && cp src/chrome/index.html src/chrome/chrome.css dist/chrome/
scripts.test:e2e: npx electron tests/e2e_electron_runner.cjs --headless --no-sandbox && npx electron tests/e2e_julestest_runner.cjs --headless --no-sandbox && npx electron tests/e2e_local_ui_visibility_runner.cjs --headless --no-sandbox && npx electron tests/e2e_stress_runner.cjs --headless --no-sandbox
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test

author: OSINTCabal
